To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example, pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Replying to: none

Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in. It is £5,087 all in, so £1,271.75 each between the four of us, same split as always. It has gone up again, near £350 on last year, but the park sets the fees and there is nothing I can do about that.

Please can you get the money to me by 31 January 2027, into the same account as before. The park wants the lot by then. If it suits anyone better to pay in two lots, that is fine — £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. Just say which you would rather do.

The weeks for 2027:

- Pete and Linda: 29 May to 5 June, May half term
- Me and Bev: 5 to 12 June, handover on the 5th
- Jan: 7 to 14 August, second week
- Carol: Easter week and a week in September

No clashes this year, so that all works out.

Pete asked about the shower tray. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in, £140 in parts. I am not putting that on the bill, it is done with.

Two reminders. Please make sure the stop tap is turned off when you leave — the park has had a go at us again about it. And the park has said vans over 15 years old need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 now, so that will be along in good time. Nothing to do yet, I just don't want anyone taken by surprise.

Any problems, give me a ring.

Regards
Mick
